as_declared.matched_unit_caveat: MATCHED-UNIT CONDITIONAL. Design-equivalence classes, observation classes, information statuses and proposed-panel counts assume one biological unit carries a single latent assignment through every arm and assay. ADOC does not provide that: adhesion is an aggregate per-embryo count, the secreted-protein mappings are unpaired, chips can share donors and epithelial and stromal cells in one chip may come from different donors, and the column-to-chip mapping for IGFBP-1 and PRL was lost (config/adoc_chip_donor_provenance.tsv). These numbers describe what a matched-unit design of this shape could identify, NOT what the current data identify.

summary.unit_assumption: MATCHED-UNIT (hypothetical). Every fibre, observation class, information status and proposed-panel count assumes one biological unit carries a single latent assignment through every arm and assay. The current data do not provide that: adhesion is an aggregate per-embryo count, the secretion mappings are explicitly unpaired, and the unit mapping is not recoverable. These counts therefore describe what a matched-unit design of this shape could identify, and are NOT claims about what the current data identify.

claim_boundary: Structural and design-identifiability facts computed by exhaustive enumeration over the model's free variables. No simulation, rate, horizon or fitted parameter enters. Design and identifiability blocks carry the matched-unit caveat; the structural block does not need it.
